propositions: CLI execution must route through a single validated lazy handler reference selected from the registry, eliminating parallel selection authorities (intercept ladders and policy frozensets).
Only the selected handler and parser modules must be imported on dispatch; unrelated optional-capability, reconciler, and handler modules must not leak into the import trace.
Registry-derived mount/init policies and handler/adapter/init metadata must exactly match pre-cutover behavior for all routes including no-auto-mount and conditional cases.
The top-level router must preserve the original command remainder argv unchanged and invoke the selected S2 factory parser exactly once with no route-level option grammar.
Confirmation, global output extraction, legacy JSON output shapes, token preservation after --, streams, exit codes, and exception propagation must match existing behavioral contracts.
